al_andalus_and_grenada_al_andalus.armyName: Al-Andalus and Grenada (Al-Andalus) - 755 AD to 1008 AD)

categories.name: Allies and Mercenaries
categories.description: The army may have allies from the relevant period of the Al-Andalus and Grenada list.

units.name: Caliph Vizier General
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Amir
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Christian Captain
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Jinetes
units.description: Jinetes have javelins. Evade. May have spear (+1) and shield (+1). Up to half of jinete units may have bow in place of javelins (+2), in which case they may not take spears. Jinetes may be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 16 points points per base.

units.name: Noble Cavalry
units.description: Noble Cavalry have light armour, javelins and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Evade. May have spear (+1). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 24 points per base.

units.name: Spearmen
units.description: Spearmen have a spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. May have light armour (+2) and javelins (+2)..

units.name: Arcehrs
units.description: Archer shave a bow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. May have light armour (+2) or shield (+2). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of five points per base.

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. May exchange javelins for bow or sling (free) or have throwing spear (+1).
